parameters.query: SELECT t.id AS task_id, t.title, t.priority, t.status, t.due_at, t.department_id, t.assigned_employee_id, e.id AS employee_id, p.id AS profile_id, p.full_name AS employee_name, d.name AS department_name, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.notifications n WHERE n.message LIKE '%' || t.id::text || '%' AND (n.title LIKE 'Task Auto-Reassigned:%' OR n.title LIKE 'Overdue Task Reassigned to You:%' OR n.message LIKE '%[REASSIGNED_ONCE]%')) AS already_reassigned FROM public.tasks t LEFT JOIN public.employees e ON e.id = t.assigned_employee_id LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = e.profile_id LEFT JOIN public.departments d ON d.id = t.department_id WHERE t.status IN ('assigned', 'in_progress') AND t.due_at < now() AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.notifications n WHERE n.message LIKE '%' || t.id::text || '%' AND n.created_at > now() - interval '30 minutes');

INSERT INTO public.notifications (profile_id, title, message, is_read)
SELECT 
  p.id, 
  'URGENT SLA BREACH: ' || '{{ $json.title }}', 
  'Task "' || '{{ $json.title }}' || '" in ' || '{{ $json.department_name || 'Operations' }}' || ' is past its SLA deadline! Ref: ' || '{{ $json.task_id }}', 
  false 
FROM public.profiles p 
WHERE p.role = 'admin'

UNION ALL

SELECT 
  NULLIF('{{ $json.profile_id }}', '')::uuid, 
  'SLA Delayed Warning: ' || '{{ $json.title }}', 
  'Your assigned task "' || '{{ $json.title }}' || '" is overdue. Ref: ' || '{{ $json.task_id }}', 
  false 
WHERE NULLIF('{{ $json.profile_id }}', '') IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
  t_ctx.task_id,
  t_ctx.title,
  t_ctx.priority,
  t_ctx.status,
  t_ctx.department_id,
  t_ctx.department_name,
  t_ctx.old_employee_id,
  t_ctx.old_profile_id,
  t_ctx.old_employee_name,
  cand.employee_id AS new_employee_id,
  cand.profile_id AS new_profile_id,
  cand.full_name AS new_employee_name,
  cand.active_tasks_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    '{{ $('Find Overdue Tasks Breaching SLA').item.json.task_id }}'::uuid AS task_id,
    '{{ $('Find Overdue Tasks Breaching SLA').item.json.title }}' AS title,
    '{{ $('Find Overdue Tasks Breaching SLA').item.json.priority }}' AS priority,
    '{{ $('Find Overdue Tasks Breaching SLA').item.json.status }}' AS status,
    NULLIF('{{ $('Find Overdue Tasks Breaching SLA').item.json.department_id }}', '')::uuid AS department_id,
    '{{ $('Find Overdue Tasks Breaching SLA').item.json.department_name || 'Operations' }}' AS department_name,
    NULLIF('{{ $('Find Overdue Tasks Breaching SLA').item.json.employee_id }}', '')::uuid AS old_employee_id,
    NULLIF('{{ $('Find Overdue Tasks Breaching SLA').item.json.profile_id }}', '')::uuid AS old_profile_id,
    '{{ $('Find Overdue Tasks Breaching SLA').item.json.employee_name || 'Previous Assignee' }}' AS old_employee_name
) t_ctx
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT
    e.id AS employee_id,
    e.profile_id,
    p.full_name,
    COUNT(t.id) AS active_tasks_count
  FROM public.employees e
  JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = e.profile_id
  LEFT JOIN public.tasks t
    ON t.assigned_employee_id = e.id
   AND t.status IN ('assigned', 'in_progress')
  WHERE e.department_id = t_ctx.department_id
    AND e.is_active = true
    AND (t_ctx.old_employee_id IS NULL OR e.id <> t_ctx.old_employee_id)
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.notifications nr
      WHERE nr.message LIKE '%' || t_ctx.task_id::text || '%'
        AND (
          nr.title LIKE 'Task Auto-Reassigned:%'
          OR nr.title LIKE 'Overdue Task Reassigned to You:%'
          OR nr.message LIKE '%[REASSIGNED_ONCE]%'
        )
    )
  GROUP BY e.id, e.profile_id, p.full_name
  ORDER BY active_tasks_count ASC, e.id ASC
  LIMIT 1
) cand ON true;

nodes.name: Find Replacement Active Staff with Lowest Workload

parameters.query:
UPDATE public.tasks
SET assigned_employee_id = '{{ $json.new_employee_id }}'::uuid,
    status = 'assigned'
WHERE id = '{{ $json.task_id }}'::uuid
  AND status = 'assigned'
RETURNING id, title, priority, status, assigned_employee_id;

nodes.name: Reassign Overdue Task to New Employee

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO public.notifications (profile_id, title, message, is_read)
SELECT
  '{{ $('Find Replacement Active Staff with Lowest Workload').item.json.new_profile_id }}'::uuid,
  'Overdue Task Reassigned to You: ' || '{{ $('Find Replacement Active Staff with Lowest Workload').item.json.title }}',
  'You have been assigned overdue task "' || '{{ $('Find Replacement Active Staff with Lowest Workload').item.json.title }}' || '" in ' || '{{ $('Find Replacement Active Staff with Lowest Workload').item.json.department_name }}' || ' (reassigned due to SLA breach). [REASSIGNED_ONCE] Ref: ' || '{{ $('Find Replacement Active Staff with Lowest Workload').item.json.task_id }}',
  false
WHERE NULLIF('{{ $('Find Replacement Active Staff with Lowest Workload').item.json.new_profile_id }}', '') IS NOT NULL

UNION ALL

SELECT
  p.id,
  'Task Auto-Reassigned: ' || '{{ $('Find Replacement Active Staff with Lowest Workload').item.json.title }}',
  'Task "' || '{{ $('Find Replacement Active Staff with Lowest Workload').item.json.title }}' || '" in ' || '{{ $('Find Replacement Active Staff with Lowest Workload').item.json.department_name }}' || ' was overdue in assigned status and has been automatically reassigned from ' || '{{ $('Find Replacement Active Staff with Lowest Workload').item.json.old_employee_name }}' || ' to ' || '{{ $('Find Replacement Active Staff with Lowest Workload').item.json.new_employee_name }}' || '. [REASSIGNED_ONCE] Ref: ' || '{{ $('Find Replacement Active Staff with Lowest Workload').item.json.task_id }}',
  false
FROM public.profiles p
WHERE p.role = 'admin';

INSERT INTO public.notifications (profile_id, title, message, is_read)
SELECT
  p.id,
  'Auto-Reassignment Unavailable: ' || '{{ $json.title }}',
  'Overdue task "' || '{{ $json.title }}' || '" in ' || '{{ $json.department_name }}' || ' is still in assigned status, but no other active employee is available in the department for reassignment. Ref: ' || '{{ $json.task_id }}',
  false
FROM public.profiles p
WHERE p.role = 'admin';
